newsitem.title: USA: DirecTV, Spain's Sogecable in deal - Variety.
newsitem.headline: DirecTV, Spain's Sogecable in deal - Variety.

text.p: Spanish pay TV giant Sogecable, a unit of France's Canal Plus SA, has reached an agreement with digital TV operator DirecTV to exploit jointly a digital TV platform for Spain, Daily Variety reported on Thursday.

The newspaper described it as the biggest Spanish TV deal of the year and said news of the accord "coursed the Spanish grapevine Wednesday." DirecTV is a unit of General Motors Corp's Hughes Electronics Corp subsidiary.
The deal could also involve Sogecable-inspired channels on DirecTV's direct-to-home digital offerings in Latin America.
"The deal will bring together some of the most powerful digital TV contenders in the world," the newspaper said.
